channel.title: Midnight blog - Last 7 days
channel.description: 记录软件从需求、架构设计、开发、测试到发布、运维与持续改进的工程实践，讨论具体约束、方案取舍和验证方法。AI 是工具链的一部分。 | Range: Last 7 days

item.title: 按钮写“提交”，用户究竟答应了什么？
item.description: 按钮标签要对应保存、送审或付款的真实动作；把点击后的状态、失败反馈与必要条件一起纳入需求评审。

item.title: CSP 的默认加载规则能限制表单提交地址吗
item.description: form-action 不回退到 default-src；按真实表单目的地检查允许范围，并单独验证重定向与业务结果。

item.title: 给组件宽度一个可验收的尺寸口径
item.description: 内容宽度与边框外沿采用不同计算口径；先确认盒模型，再排查外边距、长内容和布局约束。

item.title: 折叠详情适合补充解释，不适合藏住行动条件
item.description: 以用户决策所需的信息区分主内容与补充帮助；清楚的展开入口不能替代默认可见的重要条件。

item.title: Docker 构建命中缓存，软件包索引为什么可能已过时
item.description: RUN 缓存不会自动因时间失效；同层更新与安装修正局部失配，刷新时机与实际依赖版本仍需明确。

item.title: 两个 worktree 的文件独立，Git 引用和 stash 也独立吗
item.description: worktree 的 HEAD 和暂存区分开，常见分支与 stash 引用共享；恢复前应核对记录内容和任务归属。

item.title: 没查到记录，就能返回 410 吗？
item.description: 404 不判断缺失是否永久；410 需要源站对长期不可用有依据，响应、权限披露与缓存策略还需分别核对。

item.title: Array.fill 放入对象，为什么改一项会影响其他项
item.description: fill 重复的是同一个对象引用；独立可编辑行需要各自构造对象，并检查嵌套状态和断言预期。

item.title: Object.freeze 后，嵌套配置为什么仍会变化？
item.description: 浅冻结限制当前对象自身的属性；嵌套对象、共享引用和访问器仍需明确边界，再决定是否采用递归处理。

item.title: 容器已经 Ready，Pod 为什么还在等待自定义就绪条件
item.description: readinessGates 要求所有列出的条件为 True；缺失按 False 处理，容器就绪之外还要确认状态写入责任。

item.title: 直方图声明了单位，为什么还要检查实际记录值？
item.description: 单位元数据不能证明数值已换算；记录值、分桶、阈值及历史查询需要采用一致的测量契约。

item.title: 允许 camera 权限政策，为什么页面仍不能使用摄像头
item.description: camera 政策允许来源，仍要满足安全上下文、用户许可与设备条件；错误名称和等待状态需要分别处理。

item.title: route.continue 透传请求，也不等于还原缓存环境
item.description: 启用 Playwright 网络路由会禁用 HTTP 缓存；缓存验收应单独保留无路由环境并记录请求层次。

item.title: 列有 DEFAULT，为什么显式写入 NULL 仍没有默认值
item.description: 默认值处理省略与显式请求默认值的情况；接口应保留缺省、清空和具体取值之间的差别。

item.title: LEFT JOIN 的条件移到 WHERE，为什么未匹配行消失了
item.description: 区分联接匹配与结果过滤，用三类客户样本确定哪些行应该保留，并检查多明细造成的重复。

item.title: 时间倒序后，为什么没有时间的记录排在最前？
item.description: PostgreSQL 降序默认把空值放在前面；将空值位置、多列方向和同值顺序写进查询，并先确认空值的业务含义。

item.title: 整数计数器为什么算出了小数 increase
item.description: increase 的窗口外推可能给整数计数器算出小数；重置处理、聚合顺序与对账用途需要分别理解。

item.title: 同时设置两种容差，不表示两道门都要通过
item.description: pytest.approx 的相对与绝对容差采用或条件；先写清参考值、单位和业务误差预算，再选择参数。

item.title: 系统过载时，为什么拒绝部分请求可能比全部排队更可靠？
item.description: 过长排队消耗资源并增加无效工作；拒绝和降级也需成本、优先级、客户端反馈与恢复验收。

item.title: Blob URL 能打开文件，为什么不代表已经保存？
item.description: 临时对象地址、预览、文件保存与释放各有生命周期；明确使用者和清理责任，再验证用户实际得到的产物。

item.title: What does a “Submit” button ask the user to confirm?
item.description: Match button labels to saving, review and payment, then check the resulting state and failure feedback.

item.title: Does default-src restrict where a form submits?
item.description: CSP form destinations need their own directive. Check allowed targets, browser redirect behavior, and business outcomes separately.

item.title: Give component width a measurable box-model contract
item.description: Define whether width means content or the border edge before diagnosing padding, margins and layout overflow.

item.title: Use collapsed details for help, keep action conditions visible
item.description: Separate supplementary help from information users need before deciding, and make disclosure controls descriptive.

item.title: Why a cached Docker build can use an old package index
item.description: Package freshness needs an explicit cache decision and installed-version evidence. Combining update and installation fixes a narrower mismatch.

item.title: Do separate Git worktrees have separate references and stashes?
item.description: Worktrees keep separate HEADs and indexes while sharing ordinary references and stashes. Verify record ownership before restoring unfinished work.

item.title: Does an empty lookup justify HTTP 410?
item.description: Distinguish missing resources from traceable retirement decisions, with separate checks for disclosure and caching.

item.title: Why Array.fill makes several rows share one editable object
item.description: Repeated object references are shared state; construct independent editable rows and verify nested data and saved identities.

item.title: Why can nested settings change after Object.freeze?
item.description: Shallow freezing protects the outer object; nested references, accessors and recursive handling need explicit boundaries.

item.title: Why ready containers can leave a Pod waiting for a readiness gate
item.description: Custom readiness gates need every listed condition True; missing conditions count as False. Assign status ownership beyond container probes.

item.title: Check histogram values against their declared unit
item.description: Check measurement values, histogram boundaries and downstream thresholds against one unit contract.

item.title: Why an allowed camera policy does not make a camera usable
item.description: Camera policy, secure context, user consent, and device availability are separate checks. Test waiting and denial paths as well as success.

item.title: Passing requests through route.continue does not preserve the cache environment
item.description: Playwright routing disables HTTP caching, so browser-cache acceptance needs its own controlled environment and evidence.

item.title: Why an explicit NULL does not use a PostgreSQL column default
item.description: Keep omission, explicit clearing and supplied values distinct so database defaults receive the intended input.

item.title: Why moving a LEFT JOIN condition into WHERE removes unmatched rows
item.description: Separate join matching from result filtering, then verify customer identities and detail counts against the intended report.

item.title: Why does descending time order put missing timestamps first?
item.description: Specify null placement, individual column directions and tie handling in PostgreSQL lists, after defining what missing values mean.

item.title: Why Prometheus increase can be fractional for integer counters
item.description: Prometheus extrapolates counter increases over a query window. Interpret fractions, resets, and display precision against that measurement scope.

item.title: Two pytest.approx tolerances are alternatives, not two mandatory gates
item.description: Choose a reference value, unit and error budget before approving the relative and absolute tolerance settings.

item.title: Bound admission and degradation during service overload
item.description: Bound queueing and rejection while verifying useful outcomes, client feedback and recovery.

item.title: An accessible Blob URL does not prove a saved file
item.description: Separate temporary object addresses, previews, file saving and cleanup, then verify the artifact users actually receive.

item.title: 成功页面显示完成后，用户为什么仍不知道下一步？
item.description: 确认页说明已完成的提交、下一步、时间与查询方式；返回页面和通知状态也应有可靠含义。

item.title: CSP 禁止加载 iframe，就能阻止本站被别人嵌入吗？
item.description: frame-ancestors 控制谁可嵌入当前页；不回退到 default-src，不支持 meta，嵌套祖先需逐层核对。

item.title: Docker 发布端口后，为什么其他机器也能访问？
item.description: 发布端口需核对绑定、地址族、路由和版本；保留 28.0.0 前 localhost 发布的二层网络例外。

item.title: 表单只显示有错误，用户怎样找到需要修改的答案？
item.description: 错误摘要应关联具体答案、协调焦点和字段旁文案，保留正确输入并验证实际纠错路径。

item.title: git stash 后文件还在，哪些内容没有被暂存？
item.description: stash 的跟踪、未跟踪和忽略范围不同；清理前核对条目，恢复时保留索引与冲突证据。

item.title: 输入框禁用了，提交时为什么收不到原来的值？
item.description: 禁用控件不参与原生表单提交；核对脚本序列化、动态依赖与服务端可信来源，不把显示值当请求证据。

item.title: 收到 HTTP 405，应该修改方法还是检查目标资源？
item.description: 405 表示目标资源不支持该方法；结合 Allow、实际路由和入口排查，资源能力不等于用户权限。

item.title: 事故级别应该看告警数量，还是看实际用户影响？
item.description: 事故级别结合用户影响与响应动作；明确不确定时的升级、复核和协调责任，不照搬组织编号。

item.title: 日期字符串没写时区，为什么两种写法解析结果不同？
item.description: 标准纯日期与无时区日期时间采用不同解释；区分日历日、瞬间和当地安排，避免局部偏移修补。

item.title: 对象里有 undefined，JSON 请求为什么少了字段？
item.description: 默认 JSON 序列化对对象和数组中的 undefined 处理不同；缺失、null 与清空应有明确接口语义。

item.title: Service 的 port 改了，为什么流量没到应用监听端口？
item.description: Service 入口与目标端口不同；核对名称解析、选择器和实际监听，并验证新旧 Pod 的运行契约。

item.title: 环境变量写了 false，功能为什么仍然开启？
item.description: Node 环境值是字符串；明确布尔允许值、缺失和无效策略，在统一边界解析而非依赖真值判断。

item.title: 一个批次来自多条链路，Span 应该选谁当父级？
item.description: 多来源批次用真实操作边界表达关系；链接创建时机可能影响采样，关联不保证目标 Span 可见。

item.title: Playwright 下载事件触发了，为什么产物仍然丢失？
item.description: 下载事件、文件保存和内容验收是不同阶段；等待持久保存并核对上下文关闭、并行隔离与失败证据。

item.title: COUNT(*) 和 COUNT(字段) 为什么给出不同数量？
item.description: COUNT 的行数与非空输入口径不同；先检查过滤、连接基数和指标单位，再讨论数量与性能。

item.title: UNION 合并报表后，为什么记录数量变少了？
item.description: UNION 对结果行去重，UNION ALL 保留重复；投影、业务身份、来源与顺序应分别说明。

item.title: Prometheus 出现 exported_job，原来的标签去了哪里？
item.description: honor_labels 改变冲突标签的优先关系；追踪原始标签与服务器附加值，不为去掉前缀盲目切换。

item.title: pytest 没有 INFO 日志，是没执行还是捕获级别不对？
item.description: INFO 日志检查需明确捕获级别；区分日志记录、终端显示和业务执行，断言稳定且可归属的信息。

item.title: 站点用了 HTTPS，页面路径还会通过 Referer 发出去吗？
item.description: 来源政策按同源、跨源和降级决定发送范围；HTTPS 不替代来源信息最小化，来源头也不提供授权。

item.title: URLSearchParams 为什么把数据里的加号变成空格？
item.description: 查询文本会把加号解释为空格；用原始值调用参数接口，并核对预编码、解码与迁移边界。

item.title: Explain the next state on a confirmation page
item.description: Explain confirmed submission, next steps and reliable revisit paths on receipt pages.

item.title: Separate frame loading from frame ancestor permission
item.description: Verify frame ancestor permission in response headers separately from child-frame loading.

item.title: Review Docker published port bindings and reachability
item.description: Review Docker port exposure with binding, routing and pre-28.0.0 localhost limitations.

item.title: Connect error summaries to the answers needing correction
item.description: Connect validation summaries, focus and field messages into an actionable correction path.

item.title: Review tracked, untracked and ignored scope before stashing
item.description: Verify stash scope and entry identity before cleanup, task switching and restoration.

item.title: Account for disabled controls in form submission
item.description: Review disabled controls, actual submission data and server-owned state independently.

item.title: Interpret HTTP 405 through the target resource contract
item.description: Diagnose unsupported methods against the target resource and keep authorization separate.

item.title: Define incident severity from observable impact
item.description: Define incident impact, escalation and coordination without importing another team’s severity numbers.

item.title: Make Date.parse timezone assumptions explicit
item.description: Keep calendar dates and instants distinct when parsing strings with implicit timezone assumptions.

item.title: Define missing fields before JSON serialization
item.description: Define missing and null fields before relying on default JSON serialization behavior.

item.title: Verify Kubernetes Service target port resolution
item.description: Trace Service entry ports, named targets and actual application listeners during rollout.

item.title: Parse environment flags as an explicit configuration type
item.description: Parse environment flags with explicit accepted values and invalid-input behavior.

item.title: Represent multiple causal relationships with Span links
item.description: Represent multiple trace relationships with links and preserve sampling and visibility limits.

item.title: Await and preserve Playwright downloads before context closure
item.description: Await download persistence and validate artifacts before closing the browser context.

item.title: Choose a PostgreSQL count that matches the metric
item.description: Match PostgreSQL row and non-null counts to an explicit metric definition.

item.title: Choose duplicate semantics before using UNION
item.description: Choose set-operation duplicate semantics using explicit row identity and output requirements.

item.title: Understand Prometheus honor_labels conflicts
item.description: Trace conflicting scraped and server labels before changing honor_labels precedence.

item.title: Set a deliberate log capture level in pytest
item.description: Set log capture levels explicitly and assert meaningful records rather than terminal appearance.

item.title: Control referrer exposure separately from transport encryption
item.description: Review referrer disclosure by origin relationship and keep transport and authorization distinct.

item.title: Preserve literal plus signs in URLSearchParams values
item.description: Preserve literal plus signs by separating raw values from serialized query text.

item.title: 线上服务有人不会用，辅助渠道怎样才算完成任务？
item.description: 辅助渠道需回应真实障碍、保留用户知情并交接任务；客服工单关闭不能代替业务完成。

item.title: Docker 改了默认日志驱动，旧容器为什么没变？
item.description: 日志默认值只影响新容器；核对实际实例配置，带数据和恢复计划安排重建并验证日志出口。

item.title: Fetch 日志读过正文，业务解析为什么又失败？
item.description: 响应正文被日志消费后不能再次解析；明确消费者，在读取前决定克隆或单次解析及保留范围。

item.title: forEach 里写了 await，外层为什么提前结束？
item.description: forEach 不等待异步回调；按依赖与并发预算组织任务，明确完成、错误汇总和取消责任。

item.title: 分支推送成功，发布标签为什么还没到远程？
item.description: 分支推送不证明标签已到远程；区分标签选择范围、可达条件和源码到产物的发布证据。

item.title: HTTP 204 成功后，为什么不该继续解析 JSON？
item.description: 204 没有响应正文，仍可能包含有用元数据；解析、界面提示和重试应依据接口契约。

item.title: GET 请求带了筛选正文，为什么服务链路未必理解？
item.description: GET 正文没有通用定义的语义；源站支持不保证中间层理解，应明确查询身份与迁移契约。

item.title: 多语言列表排序，为什么需要明确 Collator 的语言？
item.description: 语言与比较选项影响显示顺序；比较相等不等于记录同一，平局和分页需要独立规则。

item.title: Kubernetes Job 重试次数，为什么不能只数失败 Pod？
item.description: Job 失败限制涉及失败 Pod 和特定策略下的容器重试；分清重试层并核对业务副作用。

item.title: Map 里存过对象，换一个相同对象为什么找不到？
item.description: Map 对象键按引用比较；根据实例或业务身份设计键范围，并分别处理版本变化与失效。

item.title: npm 开了 ignore-scripts，为什么仍能运行项目脚本？
item.description: ignore-scripts 不阻止显式目标脚本执行；安装准备、构建产物和执行权限应分阶段审查。

item.title: OAuth 回调在同一域名下，为什么仍要精确匹配？
item.description: OAuth 回调需精确匹配登记 URI；保留原生应用 localhost 端口例外，并单独审查各段跳转许可。

item.title: Span 已结束，进程退出前还需要刷新导出吗？
item.description: Span 结束不等于后端保存；为批量队列、刷新和关闭安排有限预算，保留导出确认的边界。

item.title: Playwright 重试通过后，第一次失败还要保留吗？
item.description: 重试通过仍需保留首轮失败；关联每次尝试、worker 重建与外部副作用，明确 flaky 的发布处理。

item.title: 空数组长度为什么是 NULL，什么时候用 cardinality？
item.description: array_length 检查维度，cardinality 统计总元素；空集合、未知输入和缺失维度应保留含义。

item.title: PostgreSQL RETURNING 有结果，事务就提交了吗？
item.description: RETURNING 提供实际修改行，不证明显式事务提交或外部交付完成；零行和多行也需业务解释。

item.title: Prometheus 抓取更频繁，告警为什么不一定更快？
item.description: 抓取与评估周期分别控制不同阶段；沿事件到通知核对实际时间，不从单个参数承诺延迟。

item.title: pytest 没捕获到输出，应该选 capsys 还是 capfd？
item.description: capsys 与 capfd 观察不同输出层；快照不等待任务完成，字节、文本与日志出口需要明确。

item.title: 重复工作都值得自动化吗？先判断它是不是 toil
item.description: 用 toil 特征评估重复工作，比较消除需求、工程改进和自动化，并计入失败维护负担。

item.title: 问卷把速度和质量放在一起，答案还能解释吗？
item.description: 速度与质量合并评分难以解释；先拆开决策所需概念，再检查适用人群、试答理解与历史可比性。

item.title: Design assisted digital support around task completion
item.description: Research support needs and preserve informed task completion across assistance channels.

item.title: Verify logging configuration on existing Docker containers
item.description: Verify per-container logging settings and plan recreation with data and recovery evidence.

item.title: Assign ownership before consuming a Fetch response body
item.description: Assign Fetch body ownership before reading, cloning or sharing parsed results.

item.title: Make asynchronous iteration completion explicit
item.description: Define asynchronous iteration completion, concurrency and failure policy explicitly.

item.title: Select Git tags deliberately when pushing a release
item.description: Select release tag scope deliberately and verify remote targets against build artifacts.

item.title: Handle successful HTTP 204 responses without parsing a body
item.description: Handle no-content success explicitly and keep parsing failures separate from operation outcomes.

item.title: Avoid assuming shared semantics for GET request content
item.description: Define interoperable query semantics rather than relying on private GET-body assumptions.

item.title: Define locale-sensitive ordering without changing identity
item.description: Define locale-sensitive ordering, tie handling and identity as separate contracts.

item.title: Read Job retry limits across Pods and container restarts
item.description: Read Job limits alongside Pod and container attempts without assuming business deduplication.

item.title: Choose reference or logical identity for Map keys
item.description: Choose explicit instance or business identity, scope and invalidation for Map keys.

item.title: Understand the boundary of npm ignore-scripts
item.description: Separate npm lifecycle controls, deliberate script execution and artifact completeness.

item.title: Match OAuth redirect URIs against exact registrations
item.description: Constrain OAuth redirect receivers with exact registration matching and narrow exceptions.

item.title: Budget shutdown time for batched OpenTelemetry spans
item.description: Budget batched Span shutdown and distinguish delivery confirmation from backend persistence.

item.title: Keep first-failure evidence when Playwright retries pass
item.description: Preserve first-failure evidence and attempt identity when Playwright retries succeed.

item.title: Distinguish array dimensions from total cardinality
item.description: Distinguish array dimension length, total element count and unknown business states.

item.title: Separate RETURNING rows from transaction commit
item.description: Separate modified-row results, confirmed transaction commit and external delivery.

item.title: Separate Prometheus scraping from rule evaluation
item.description: Trace scraping, evaluation and later notification stages before changing alert timing.

item.title: Match pytest output capture to the writing boundary
item.description: Match pytest capture fixtures and snapshot timing to the actual output boundary.

item.title: Choose automation work by toil characteristics
item.description: Assess toil characteristics and failure workload before selecting automation investments.

item.title: Separate concepts in double-barreled survey questions
item.description: Separate survey concepts and preserve the context needed to interpret answers.

item.title: 提交前能查看答案，为什么还需要直接修改和返回？
item.description: 核对页需支持直接纠错并保留任务；编辑后处理依赖问题，区分核对、修改与最终提交。

item.title: Cookie 设置了 Path，就能隔离同站点的敏感功能吗？
item.description: Path 控制 Cookie 发送范围而非业务授权；同名值、迁移与注销要按实际范围及服务端会话分别核对。

item.title: 容器已经 unhealthy，为什么没有按重启策略恢复？
item.description: 独立 Docker 的健康状态与退出条件不同；明确恢复执行者，并验证进行中任务与最终业务结果。

item.title: 错误预算耗尽后，是否所有变更都应该停止？
item.description: 错误预算政策需范围、窗口、例外与解除条件；紧急修复仍绑定版本、责任和验证证据。

item.title: 表单里的每个字段，谁能说明收集以后用来做什么？
item.description: 每个表单字段都需要用途、适用人群与维护责任；问题协议先于页面措辞，不用未来可能分析代替收集理由。

item.title: 文件写进 gitignore，为什么改动仍然会被 Git 看到？
item.description: gitignore 不改变已跟踪文件；停止跟踪、清理历史与撤销秘密分开，干净检出还需初始化证据。

item.title: 请求写了 Accept，客户端为什么仍要检查响应类型？
item.description: Accept 表达媒体偏好，仍需核对实际类型、状态和正文；通配范围不扩大解析能力。

item.title: Content-Length 为什么不等于解压后的正文长度？
item.description: Content-Length 针对字节与表示层，编码后长度不能直接比较解压内容；进度与业务完整性需要分开。

item.title: JSON 解析没报错，长编号为什么还是变了？
item.description: JSON 数字语法正确不保证长编号精确；在数值转换前保留身份，逐层核对而不从舍入值猜原文。

item.title: 配置 Always 后，为什么仍然会复用本地镜像层？
item.description: Always 可复用匹配层，标签变化也不重算已有默认策略；核对摘要、真实对象与运行版本。

item.title: 按钮透明了，为什么仍然能被点击和聚焦？
item.description: 透明控件仍可能接收点击与焦点；视觉、交互和恢复状态需协调，不以截图代替任务验收。

item.title: 记录异常事件后，Span 状态为什么仍不是错误？
item.description: 手动埋点分别处理异常事件与操作状态；恢复结果、上下文归属和敏感内容仍需明确判断。

item.title: 网络空闲了，测试为什么还不能直接宣布页面就绪？
item.description: 网络空闲不证明业务就绪；根据实际任务断言目标状态，保留错误、空结果和旧结果的区别。

item.title: numeric 限定两位小数，为什么没有拒绝更多小数？
item.description: numeric 比例约束可能舍入输入；校验、保存和计算规则分别定义，不从处理后值伪造原始精度。

item.title: 事务回滚了，序列编号为什么没有退回去？
item.description: 序列值不随回滚回收，空洞不等于已提交记录丢失；业务编号、统计和外部交付需独立确认。

item.title: 记录规则有结果，原来的实例标签为什么不见了？
item.description: 记录规则产生新序列，表达式和配置都影响标签；逐层核对身份、窗口与下游使用契约。

item.title: 主任务成功了，finally 为什么仍能让调用链失败？
item.description: finally 清理抛错或拒绝会改变调用链结果；区分主任务与清理状态，避免错误恢复重复副作用。

item.title: 标记 xfail 的测试恢复通过，为什么流水线仍可能放行？
item.description: xfail 的意外通过受严格设置影响；维护原因、范围和退出条件，核对真实断言而非只看绿灯。

item.title: 登录后返回地址，怎样避免变成任意跳转入口？
item.description: 返回地址需批准映射或解析后许可判断；站内路径仍需授权，校验失败应有安全落点。

item.title: 新标签页里的 sessionStorage，为什么会带着旧值？
item.description: sessionStorage 可从 opener 初始复制，之后独立；重载不等于清空，草稿应关联任务与恢复条件。

item.title: Make pre-submission review editable without restarting the journey
item.description: Preserve task identity and dependent answers during pre-submission correction.

item.title: Use cookie paths for sending scope rather than authorization
item.description: Keep cookie sending scope separate from object authorization and session revocation.

item.title: Distinguish container health from the restart policy trigger
item.description: Separate health detection, restart triggers and actual business recovery in standalone Docker.

item.title: Define error-budget restrictions and exceptions before an incident
item.description: Define error-budget restrictions, exceptions and release evidence before urgent decisions.

item.title: Require a purpose for every form question
item.description: Define necessity, users and maintenance ownership before adding form fields.

item.title: Separate ignoring untracked paths from removing tracked content
item.description: Separate ignoring, tracking state, historical content and secret-response responsibilities.

item.title: Verify the response beyond the requested media preference
item.description: Check actual response type, status and body beyond requested media preferences.

item.title: Measure HTTP body length at the right encoding layer
item.description: Compare lengths only across matching units and representation layers.

item.title: Preserve long identifiers before numeric parsing loses precision
item.description: Preserve exact identifiers before numeric conversion and inspect every transport boundary.

item.title: Track image identity beyond tag names and pull-policy labels
item.description: Verify image digests and actual pull policy without treating cache reuse as stale deployment.

item.title: Separate visual transparency from interaction availability
item.description: Coordinate transparency, interaction availability and focus instead of relying on appearance.

item.title: Record exceptions and operation status as separate decisions
item.description: Classify operation status separately from exception events and verify context ownership.

item.title: Assert task readiness instead of relying on network silence
item.description: Assert task-specific readiness rather than inferring completion from quiet connections.

item.title: Separate numeric storage rounding from input validation
item.description: Separate numeric rounding, input acceptance and calculation policy.

item.title: Treat sequence values as identifiers rather than gapless accounting
item.description: Distinguish allocated sequence values from committed records and completed business work.

item.title: Review the label contract of a recorded metric
item.description: Trace recorded metric identity through expressions, label overrides and downstream consumers.

item.title: Give cleanup failures an explicit outcome policy
item.description: Separate main-operation outcomes from cleanup failures and retry decisions.

item.title: Make unexpected passes visible in expected-failure tests
item.description: Review XPASS behavior and exception ownership against current pytest settings.

item.title: Validate redirect destinations as a navigation trust boundary
item.description: Constrain navigation destinations with approved mappings and explicit parsed-component checks.

item.title: Understand per-tab storage without assuming a blank initial state
item.description: Model initial storage copying, independent tab changes and draft recovery explicitly.

item.title: 收到 429 后，什么时候重试才有依据？
item.description: 429 不定义所有配额范围，Retry-After 也不保证再次成功；用总预算、取消和结果状态约束重试。

item.title: 只改一个字段，为什么不能把 PUT 当作局部更新？
item.description: PUT 替换表示与 PATCH 修改指令不同；明确省略、空值、重复执行和并发条件，避免由实现偶然决定更新含义。

item.title: npm audit fix --force 修复了报告，就能直接发布吗？
item.description: 强制修复可能跨版本范围；报告阈值不清除问题，发布需核对实际依赖变更和业务回归。

item.title: 镜像中的文件换了，挂载卷里为什么还是旧内容？
item.description: 空卷首次复制不是持续同步，已有卷遮住镜像目录；迁移与镜像回退需要独立的数据兼容证据。

item.title: 功能已经全量开放，开关为什么还需要退役计划？
item.description: 功能开关按用途定义寿命、负责人和退役条件，清理临时分支与维护长期控制需要不同契约。

item.title: 二分定位到了提交，为什么还不能直接宣布根因？
item.description: 二分定位依赖可信好坏判定；环境失败应区分，跳过与不稳定性保持未知，提交身份不等于根因。

item.title: revert 之后，原来的提交为什么还在历史里？
item.description: revert 新增反向提交而不删除历史；合并父节点和当前差异需审查，源码变化不代替运行恢复。

item.title: await 网络请求以后，IndexedDB 事务为什么已经结束？
item.description: IndexedDB 活动事务受任务边界约束；准备输入后再写，单请求成功不代表整笔事务完成。

item.title: 列表排序后，原来的数组为什么也变了？
item.description: sort 修改原数组，复制容器也可能共享对象；明确展示顺序、记录所有权和比较规则。

item.title: CronJob 按时创建了 Job，就能保证业务只执行一次吗？
item.description: CronJob 不保证业务恰好一次；计划时间、业务身份、并发范围和重试结果需要分别记录。

item.title: 日志里有 TraceId，就一定能打开完整链路吗？
item.description: TraceId 提供关联身份，不保证链路已保留；核对上下文归属、采样、查询范围与访问条件。

item.title: 每组只取一条记录，怎样确定拿到的是哪一条？
item.description: DISTINCT ON 需要明确组内优先级；代表行不是组汇总，并列与迟到数据要有选择依据。

item.title: NOT IN 为什么没有返回预期的未匹配记录？
item.description: NOT IN 遇到空值可能返回未知；先定义身份缺失的业务规则，再核对排除查询与改写等价性。

item.title: 时间字符串带偏移，数据库为什么没有按时区转换？
item.description: 时间输入偏移是否参与解释取决于类型；区分时间点、本地时间、显示时区与历史来源。

item.title: 指标消失了，为什么不能直接当作零流量？
item.description: 缺少样本不是零流量；根据预期目标检查采集覆盖，总体数值不能证明每个实例完整。

item.title: 实验室任务顺利，为什么还要观察用户自己的设备？
item.description: 用参与者自己的设备与材料识别任务环境，区分界面问题、协作等待与干扰，不把受控会话外推为日常保证。

item.title: 给 CDN 脚本加了 integrity，为什么仍加载失败？
item.description: SRI 同时依赖预期字节与跨源条件；哈希匹配不证明代码可信，更新和回退需要维护审查关系。

item.title: 测试替换了全局函数，怎样限制它影响的范围？
item.description: 限制全局补丁影响范围与恢复时机；恢复引用不回滚外部副作用，环境变量还需核对读取时机。

item.title: 固定 Date 以后，定时器为什么仍按真实时间运行？
item.description: 固定日期与推进定时器不同；核对安装顺序、版本与后端时间边界，仍需业务结果断言。

item.title: 用 URL 拼接口地址，末尾斜杠为什么会改变结果？
item.description: URL 按目录与源解析相对地址，斜杠影响路径；语法解析成功不能替代目的地授权。

item.title: Bound retries after a rate-limit response
item.description: Bound rate-limit retries with response hints, cancellation and an overall waiting budget.

item.title: Define replacement and patch instructions before choosing an update method
item.description: Distinguish replacement from patch instructions, including omissions, nulls and concurrency.

item.title: Review forced dependency remediation as a compatibility change
item.description: Review forced dependency fixes for compatibility rather than treating a cleaner report as acceptance.

item.title: Distinguish first-volume initialization from later image updates
item.description: Separate initial volume copying from image updates, migrations and data-compatible rollback.

item.title: Give feature flags an owner and a retirement condition
item.description: Define flag ownership and retirement while treating long-lived operational controls separately.

item.title: Define a reliable predicate before interpreting a bisect result
item.description: Use a reliable bisect predicate and preserve uncertainty before making causal claims.

item.title: Separate a recorded revert from history removal and live rollback
item.description: Keep reversal history and production recovery distinct when reviewing a revert.

item.title: Keep remote waits outside the local transaction lifetime
item.description: Respect IndexedDB task boundaries and distinguish request success from transaction completion.

item.title: Separate array ordering from shared data ownership
item.description: Separate array ordering, record mutation and shared input ownership.

item.title: Give scheduled work a business identity beyond its Job
item.description: Give scheduled work stable business identity and durable outcomes beyond Job creation.

item.title: Correlate logs with trace context without promising retained spans
item.description: Correlate logs using real context while preserving trace-retention and visibility limits.

item.title: Define the representative row before using DISTINCT ON
item.description: Define representative-row precedence and validate ties and late arrivals before deduplication.

item.title: Keep null semantics visible in exclusion queries
item.description: Preserve unknown identity semantics when designing and rewriting exclusion queries.

item.title: Choose timestamp types from the meaning of the stored value
item.description: Choose timestamp storage from instant or local-time meaning and preserve original zone intent separately.

item.title: Treat missing telemetry separately from a measured zero
item.description: Keep missing telemetry distinct from measured zero and inspect expected target coverage.

item.title: Observe the task context beyond a controlled research session
item.description: Inspect real task constraints without treating a controlled session as everyday-use proof.

item.title: Keep integrity hashes, bytes and cross-origin permissions aligned
item.description: Align expected bytes and cross-origin permissions without treating integrity as code trust.

item.title: Limit monkeypatch scope and restore temporary dependencies
item.description: Limit patch scope and distinguish restored references from undone external effects.

item.title: Control date values and timer progression deliberately
item.description: Control date values and timer progression according to the behavior being tested.

item.title: Resolve relative URLs with an explicit base-path contract
item.description: Make base-path semantics explicit and keep URL parsing separate from destination permission.

item.title: 工作流被路径过滤跳过，为什么 PR 仍在等检查？
item.description: 工作流过滤跳过可能让必需检查待定；区分作业跳过与实际成功，让门禁对应当前提交和真实结果。

item.title: CSP nonce 应该跟着构建，还是跟着响应变化？
item.description: CSP nonce 按响应生成且与许可标签匹配；缓存和模板注入需共同检查，不对未知脚本无差别授权。

item.title: 容器停机信号为什么没到应用进程？
item.description: 先确认入口进程与信号交接，再评估停机时间；exec 改变清理责任，启动成功不证明结束正确。

item.title: 下载文件名为什么不能直接当作本地路径？
item.description: 下载文件名只是建议；分别控制保存目录、存储身份和内容处理，国际化解析不替代安全判断。

item.title: HEAD 返回 200，为什么仍需验证 GET 正文？
item.description: HEAD 成功不验证 GET 正文；结合访问条件核对内容、元数据和实际发布范围。

item.title: 故障处理中，谁来决定优先级和接手时机？
item.description: 故障管理明确指挥、操作、沟通与交接责任；假设、影响和恢复证据分开，兼任也需明确归属。

item.title: 配置 PDB 后，哪些中断仍然可能发生？
item.description: PDB 约束特定自愿中断，不能阻止节点故障或代替滚动更新策略；副本数量也不证明服务容量。

item.title: 网络分块切断中文字符，应该在哪一层处理？
item.description: 保留跨块字符的解码状态，再独立处理消息分帧、大小上限和输入结束；正确解码不代表消息完整。

item.title: write 返回 false 后，Node.js 流应该怎样继续？
item.description: write 返回 false 后等待 drain；highWaterMark 是阈值，背压与取消、缓冲预算及业务确认需要分别设计。

item.title: Delta 和 Cumulative 指标为什么不能混着相加？
item.description: Delta 与 Cumulative 的区间语义不同；保留起止时间、序列身份及重启处理，避免重复计算或假定缺失为零。

item.title: 改完密码，旧登录会话就一定失效了吗？
item.description: 密码恢复还需旧会话与恢复渠道策略；疑似失陷时核对控制权，不能仅以新密码可用宣布恢复。

item.title: 定位到两个按钮时，为什么不该直接加 first？
item.description: 定位器歧义先确认业务身份与区域；first 只选择位置，不证明目标正确，等待也不能消除身份问题。

item.title: 连接池里的 PostgreSQL 咨询锁，什么时候才会释放？
item.description: 咨询锁按会话或事务释放，连接归还不等于会话结束；检查重复取得、清理与外部副作用边界。

item.title: 计数器重启过，为什么要先 rate 再 sum？
item.description: 先对每条计数器求 rate，再汇总以保留重置信息；窗口、指标类型与实例排查需要分别解释。

item.title: 原型已经能用，为什么还不能直接上线？
item.description: 原型用于研究假设，生产承担真实数据与运行责任；逐项确认复用条件，不以可点击页面代替上线验收。

item.title: pytest 参数化测试为什么会互相改到输入？
item.description: 参数化不自动复制输入；核对共享对象、嵌套可变值和预期结果，避免只修复当前运行顺序。

item.title: useId 解决什么身份问题，又不能替代什么？
item.description: useId 用于可访问性关联，不替代列表键或业务主键；服务端渲染需两侧组件树一致。

item.title: 研究笔记怎样区分观察、解释和下一步行动？
item.description: 研究笔记把观察、解释与行动分开，保留原话出处和竞争假设，不把会议共识当作更多用户证据。

item.title: SQLite 声明了外键，为什么还要检查每条连接？
item.description: SQLite 外键需在每条连接确认执行，并在事务外配置；表定义和开启开关都不能证明历史数据正确。

item.title: 移动端看着正常，放大后为什么仍可能不可用？
item.description: 放大重排需保留信息与功能；分别检查手机和桌面放大，二维内容例外不覆盖整张页面。

item.title: Keep required checks observable when a workflow is filtered out
item.description: Keep required-check results tied to the current commit when workflows or jobs are skipped.

item.title: Scope a CSP nonce to the HTTP response that carries it
item.description: Generate response-scoped CSP nonces and keep policy, approved tags and caches consistent.

item.title: Make the container entrypoint hand off signals deliberately
item.description: Inspect entrypoint process ownership and signal handoff before evaluating shutdown budgets.

item.title: Treat a download filename as a suggestion, not a local path
item.description: Separate suggested download names from authorized destinations and permitted content handling.

item.title: A successful HEAD response does not verify the GET body
item.description: Verify GET content under the reader’s access conditions beyond successful HEAD metadata.

item.title: Assign incident command before parallel fixes collide
item.description: Coordinate incident roles, active changes and accepted handovers with explicit evidence limits.

item.title: Use a PodDisruptionBudget within its disruption scope
item.description: Review PDB disruption scope separately from rollouts, fault domains and service capacity.

item.title: Decode split text characters without confusing them with message frames
item.description: Preserve split-character decoding state, then apply independent framing and end-of-input rules.

item.title: Respect writable backpressure before sending more chunks
item.description: Respect backpressure and define cancellation, buffer budgets and business acknowledgment separately.

item.title: Preserve metric temporality before combining reported values
item.description: Preserve metric intervals and temporality across collection, conversion and restart boundaries.

item.title: Password recovery needs an explicit session-revocation policy
item.description: Define session and recovery-channel handling beyond acceptance of a new password.

item.title: Resolve locator ambiguity before choosing the first match
item.description: Resolve locator identity and scope before relying on positional selection or longer waits.

item.title: Advisory-lock ownership must match the connection lifetime
item.description: Match advisory-lock scope to pooled-session ownership and explicit cleanup boundaries.

item.title: Calculate each counter rate before aggregating replicas
item.description: Preserve counter-reset context by calculating per-series rates before aggregation.

item.title: A working prototype still needs a production boundary
item.description: Evaluate production responsibilities separately from the interaction a prototype helps study.

item.title: Avoid mutable aliases between parametrized test cases
item.description: Inspect mutable aliases and independent expectations instead of relying on test ordering.

item.title: Use React useId for accessibility relationships, not data identity
item.description: Use useId for accessibility relationships while preserving data identity and matching render trees.

item.title: Separate research observations from interpretations and actions
item.description: Keep observed research evidence, competing explanations and proposed actions distinct.

item.title: Verify SQLite foreign-key enforcement on each connection
item.description: Check foreign-key enforcement per SQLite connection before transactions, without assuming historical validity.

item.title: Test zoom reflow separately from a narrow mobile viewport
item.description: Verify information and operations after zoom reflow, keeping two-dimensional exceptions local.

item.title: 提交显示 Verified，就代表代码已经审查了吗？
item.description: Verified 说明签名验证，不能代替代码批准；把签名、审查、检查与部署分别绑定具体提交。

item.title: ConfigMap 改了，应用为什么还在用旧配置？
item.description: ConfigMap 更新与应用采用是不同阶段；区分环境变量、挂载与 subPath，并记录有效配置版本。

item.title: CORS 报错了，就能确定请求没有执行吗？
item.description: CORS 错误不能证明业务未执行；区分预检和响应读取，关联服务端证据并设计未知结果恢复。

item.title: POST 跳转后变成 GET，服务端到底接收了什么？
item.description: POST 重定向需要区分方法保留与结果展示；同时检查正文重放、目标边界和重复副作用。

item.title: 同一个网址，缓存为什么给错了语言版本？
item.description: Vary 参与缓存表示匹配；核对语言、默认分支与代理输出，并分别审查私人数据和授权边界。

item.title: 页面流程通了，用户为什么仍卡在部门交接处？
item.description: 页面操作成功不等于用户任务完成；从跨部门交接、材料接收与责任归属识别旅程断点。

item.title: 覆盖率很高，测试为什么仍放过错误的比较符？
item.description: 变异存活提示测试敏感性问题；逐项核对业务含义、输入缺口与断言，避免只为分数绑定实现细节。

item.title: 用了 npm ci，就能保证两台机器产物完全相同吗？
item.description: npm ci 冻结安装不等于构建完全复现；记录运行时、参数与配置，先定义产物允许哪些差异。

item.title: CHECK 写着大于零，为什么空值仍能保存？
item.description: CHECK 为真或空值都可满足；把必填、数值范围与业务阶段分别定义，避免把未知批量改成零。

item.title: RLS 策略写好了，为什么应用仍能读到所有租户？
item.description: RLS 是否生效取决于运行角色和策略；区分高权限绕过、表所有者及读写路径，不以管理员查询代替验收。

item.title: SKIP LOCKED 查不到任务，就代表队列空了吗？
item.description: SKIP LOCKED 的空结果不代表队列清空；分别记录领取、完成与恢复，并检查顺序和公平性需求。

item.title: VACUUM 完成了，数据库文件为什么没有变小？
item.description: 普通 VACUUM 主要让空间复用，FULL 重写有额外空间和锁成本；按容量目标选择维护与验收指标。

item.title: 多个实例的 P95，为什么不能直接取平均？
item.description: 实例 P95 不能直接平均成整体 P95；先定义请求总体、窗口与指标形式，再审查分布聚合和局部问题。

item.title: 随机输入测了很多次，怎样知道断言没有写错？
item.description: 属性测试还需要独立正确性依据；审查业务属性、输入领域和关键案例，不把大量生成当作证明。

item.title: 可以算出的 React 状态，为什么还要用 Effect 同步？
item.description: React 派生值通常在渲染时计算；区分独立编辑、外部同步与性能优化，避免维护多份重复状态。

item.title: 关闭动画以后，用户还能看出操作状态吗？
item.description: 减少动态效果仍需完整状态反馈；分别检查运动、文字、脚本实现与会话中偏好变化。

item.title: 正则能校验输入，为什么也可能拖住服务？
item.description: 正则校验也需要资源边界；结合模式、引擎和输入规模审查失败路径，核对处理预算能否真正停止工作。

item.title: 同意参加访谈，就能把录音交给任何工具吗？
item.description: 研究同意需要关联录音、转写与分享副本；引入外部工具前核对用途、接收方与退出路径。

item.title: structuredClone 以后，原来的 buffer 为什么不能用了？
item.description: transfer 会改变资源使用权；在接口中明确原持有者、异步失败和重试数据的责任。

item.title: Webhook 的 JSON 没变，签名为什么校验失败？
item.description: Webhook 签名针对原始请求内容；先核对中间件、端点秘密与字节，再分别设计去重和完成记录。

item.title: A verified signature is not a code-review receipt
item.description: Bind signature verification, review, checks and deployment evidence to their exact commits.

item.title: Configuration delivery and application reload are separate events
item.description: Trace ConfigMap consumption, propagation and effective application versions across environment and volume boundaries.

item.title: A CORS error does not establish that the server did nothing
item.description: Locate the CORS failure stage and correlate server outcomes before deciding whether a side-effecting action can be retried.

item.title: Redirect status codes carry a request-method contract
item.description: Choose redirect semantics from submission intent, then inspect body replay, destinations and duplicate effects.

item.title: A URL alone cannot identify every cached representation
item.description: Match cached representations against actual selection fields, including defaults and proxies, with separate privacy checks.

item.title: Map the handoff beyond a successful page flow
item.description: Inspect cross-team ownership, evidence acceptance and truthful status beyond a successful page flow.

item.title: Use surviving mutants to inspect assertion gaps
item.description: Interpret surviving mutants against business behavior and input gaps before adding implementation-coupled assertions.

item.title: A frozen install is only one input to a reproducible build
item.description: Inventory runtime, options and configuration beyond frozen installation, then define permitted artifact differences.

item.title: A CHECK constraint is not a required-value declaration
item.description: Separate CHECK ranges, required values and business stages without converting unknown data into false zeroes.

item.title: Test row security with the actual application role
item.description: Verify RLS with the runtime role, separating privileged bypass, ownership and read-write paths.

item.title: An empty SKIP LOCKED result is not an empty queue
item.description: Distinguish empty claims from completed queues and define durable ownership, recovery and ordering requirements.

item.title: Reusable database space is different from a smaller file
item.description: Distinguish reusable space from file shrinkage and assess rewrite capacity and access costs before maintenance.

item.title: Aggregate distributions before estimating a fleet quantile
item.description: Define the population, window and distribution representation before estimating a fleet quantile.

item.title: Property tests still need an independent behavioral claim
item.description: Review independent properties, meaningful domains and explicit boundaries rather than treating generated input volume as proof.

item.title: Calculate derived values before introducing synchronized state
item.description: Separate derived display values, independent edits and external synchronization before storing another state copy.

item.title: Reduced motion still needs clear state feedback
item.description: Keep clear operation states while reducing motion across styles, scripts and preference changes.

item.title: Regular-expression validation needs an execution budget
item.description: Review regex pattern, engine and input size together, including whether resource limits actually stop processing.

item.title: Research consent needs a traceable data-use boundary
item.description: Trace research consent through recordings, transcripts and recipients before introducing another processing tool.

item.title: Transferring a buffer changes ownership rather than making a second copy
item.description: Define buffer ownership, original-holder access and retry recovery before choosing transfer over copying.

item.title: Verify webhook signatures before changing the request body
item.description: Verify original webhook bytes and endpoint secrets before parsing, with separate deduplication and completion records.

item.title: OIDC 不再保存长期密钥，谁还能换到云权限？
item.description: OIDC 减少长期密钥保存，仍需限定工作流身份与云权限；核对新仓库 subject 格式和环境审批路径。

item.title: 告警一直满足阈值，为什么迟迟没有触发？
item.description: 告警等待针对稳定标签集合；动态值放说明信息，区分数据缺失、规则触发与后续通知交付。

item.title: Deployment 滚动更新完成，业务验收为什么仍未结束？
item.description: Deployment 更新完成需另做业务验收；连同原因与版本读取状态，进度期限不自动提供回滚。

item.title: 文件没有提交到 Git，构建上下文里就没有它吗？
item.description: Git 忽略不控制 Docker 上下文；核对实际目录、忽略规则优先级与例外，并单独检查镜像产物。

item.title: 浏览器校验通过，服务端还要检查什么？
item.description: 浏览器校验用于及时反馈，服务端仍需核对格式、授权和当前业务状态，并提供可修正的错误。

item.title: 上游超时了，下游任务为什么仍在消耗资源？
item.description: 上游超时不证明下游停止：传播剩余预算，让执行器响应取消，并单独处理已经提交的业务副作用。

item.title: 断点续传怎样避免拼接两个版本的文件？
item.description: 断点续传应绑定表示版本，核对响应范围；完整响应进入替换流程，避免把不同版本的字节拼在一起。

item.title: JWT 签名正确，为什么仍可能用错了令牌？
item.description: JWT 签名有效仍需验证发行者、接受方与用途，认证之后还要检查资源权限，避免令牌跨用途混用。

item.title: 密码哈希要升级，为什么不能只替换算法名字？
item.description: 密码哈希升级需保留旧验证路径，确认新记录持久化，并评估长期未登录账户、并发改密和回滚兼容。

item.title: 点击成功后立刻断言，测试为什么偶尔失败？
item.description: 点击结束不证明业务完成；等待可重读的结果条件，区分短暂提示、持久状态与失败路径。

item.title: 国际化不能只给英文单词加一个 s
item.description: 复数类别负责选择消息，完整句子仍需翻译；区分基数、序数、零状态与未知数量。

item.title: 同一事务里时间没变，是数据库时钟停了吗？
item.description: CURRENT_TIMESTAMP 不变源于事务时间语义；按业务事件选择取时点，避免把时间戳当成全局顺序。

item.title: 外键能级联删除，业务就应该级联吗？
item.description: 根据对象所有权与生命周期选择外键删除动作，审查共享引用、软删除规则与恢复边界。

item.title: 保存点让导入继续了，怎样说明哪些记录失败？
item.description: 保存点只恢复局部改动，部分导入仍需明确外层提交、稳定记录身份、失败报告与重试契约。

item.title: 复盘写了改进项，怎样确认它真的降低了风险？
item.description: 复盘改进项应关联失败路径与可推翻完成判断的验收证据，区分任务关闭、检测改进和风险降低。

item.title: 扩大 fixture 作用域，测试为何开始互相影响？
item.description: 扩大 fixture 作用域也扩大共享状态寿命；分离昂贵资源与测试上下文，检查失败清理和并行外部资源。

item.title: OIDC removes stored cloud keys, not the need for narrow trust
item.description: Narrow workflow trust and cloud roles, accounting for repository subject-format changes and approval paths.

item.title: Changing alert labels can keep resetting the pending period
item.description: Stable alert identity matters to pending duration; distinguish missing data, firing and downstream delivery.

item.title: A complete Deployment rollout still needs business acceptance
item.description: Separate version identity, controller completion and business acceptance; progress deadlines only signal stalled rollout.

item.title: Git ignore rules do not define the Docker build context
item.description: Inspect actual context sources, ignore precedence and exceptions, then verify build artifacts separately.

item.title: What the server must check after browser validation passes
item.description: Keep immediate input feedback separate from server authorization and current-state acceptance.

item.title: Why downstream work can survive an upstream timeout
item.description: Propagate remaining budgets, stop spawned work and handle committed effects separately from RPC cancellation.

item.title: Resuming a download without joining two file versions
item.description: Bind saved bytes to a representation and separate append, replacement and integrity checks.

item.title: A valid JWT signature does not establish the intended recipient
item.description: Validate intended issuer, audience and purpose, then authorize the requested resource separately.

item.title: Password-hash upgrades need a migration path, not just a new name
item.description: Plan legacy verification, authenticated upgrades, dormant-account recovery and rollback compatibility together.

item.title: A completed click is not a completed business operation
item.description: Wait for rereadable business outcomes rather than treating a completed click or transient notice as durable success.

item.title: Plural rules select categories, not translated sentences
item.description: Select complete localized messages, keeping cardinal, ordinal, zero-state and unknown-count semantics distinct.

item.title: An unchanged transaction timestamp is not a stopped clock
item.description: Match transaction, statement and observation timestamps to the event each field is meant to record.

item.title: Choose cascading deletion from ownership, not convenience
item.description: Choose referential deletion from lifetimes, shared references and recovery requirements.

item.title: Savepoints do not replace a partial-import report
item.description: Partial imports need stable input identities and trustworthy commit reports beyond local savepoint recovery.

item.title: An incident action closes when its risk reduction is checked
item.description: Tie incident actions to failure paths and falsifiable acceptance, without equating closed tasks with quantified risk reduction.

item.title: A broader fixture scope also broadens shared state
item.description: Broader fixture reuse needs explicit initial state, failure cleanup and external-resource isolation.
